items.text: Jacksonville (final): OUT - C Robert Hainsey (knee; Jonah Monheim starts), DE Danny Striggow (concussion, downgraded Sat, not traveling), DE B.J. Green II (forearm, IR return). QUESTIONABLE - DT Matt Dickerson (neck). WR Jakobi Meyers and RB Bhayshul Tuten no designation. Trevor Lawrence starts.

NY Giants (final): no game designations. CB Nic Jones and S Elijah Campbell limited Fri, TE Isaiah Likely DNP but not designated. IR - LB Brian Burns, LB Tremaine Edmunds, RB Tyrone Tracy Jr., QB Jaxson Dart. J.J. McCarthy starts.
